note: SE Blog SEO Score v1 weights. Standalone; never blended with the Content GEO Score. One page type (blog article). No stage multipliers (see SEO_Scoring_Standard_v1.md section 3.3). Weights sum to 100.

level_anchors._doc: When the listed checks pass (na counts as met; at least one must pass), the level is at least L, unless a cap or gate lowers it.

level_caps._doc: unless_pass: if any listed check FAILS, level capped at max.

S2.why: title outside the length band is very likely rewritten/truncated (Zyppy: >60 chars 76%, >70 chars 99.9% rewritten) -> S2 max 3 (calibration v1)

S8.why: no named human author -> S8 max 2
byline not linked to the named author's own bio -> S8 max 3 (calibration v1)

S9.why: no first-hand experience and no first-party data -> S9 max 3 (calibration v1)

SG1.desc: Spam-policy pattern on the page: hidden text/links, keyword or location blocks, gibberish with keywords, scraped/uncited copy, doorway templating, leftover AI artefacts

SG2.desc: Primary query never answered, or thin page with no substantive content beyond boilerplate

SG3.desc: Unsafe or false technical/safety statement (YMYL electrical safety) - escalate to an SME

SG4.desc: Title, H1 or meta promise not delivered, or a misleading/exaggerated title

SG5.desc: No H1/main visible title (missing <title> is handled by the S2 cap)

SG6.desc: Core content only in an image, PDF, video or JS widget with no HTML-text equivalent

SG7.desc: Fake freshness: future date, or visible/markup date bumped with evidence of no substantive change

SG8.desc: Internal factual contradiction (prose vs table vs summary vs metadata)

E2.name: Indexable (no noindex in meta/X-Robots-Tag; not disallowed in robots.txt)

E3.name: One absolute HTTPS self-referencing (or valid) canonical

E4.name: hreflang valid and reciprocal, with x-default (na if none)

E6.name: Mobile: viewport width=device-width and same primary content

E8.name: Body text and links in server HTML as <a href>
